reason: The heading that opens Part One's second section is printed 'Andra delen' (Second Part) where the work has a section, not a part. Read as printed it opens a fifth part in a work that has four, and everything under it -- the Creed, questions 33 to 217 -- hangs off that phantom part instead of under Part One.
evidence: This same edition's own table of contents prints 'Andra avdelningen – den kristna trosbekännelsen' at the corresponding entry, and prints 'Andra delen – firandet av det kristna mysteriet' for the actual second part further down. The other nine editions all set a section here (EN 'Section Two The Profession of the Christian Faith'). The anchor text is unique in the page: the two other occurrences of 'Andra delen' are followed by an en dash and by the word 'kallas'.
